Package io.jstach.rainbowgum.json.encoder

@NullMarked package io.jstach.rainbowgum.json.encoder
Common JSON encoders like GELF, ECS, Logstash's, and Logback's own JSON format.

The Service Loaded configurators add:

  • GELF JSON Encoder to encoder registry with "gelf" URI scheme.
  • Elastic Common Schema (ECS) Encoder to encoder registry with "ecs" URI scheme.
  • logstash-logback-encoder style Encoder to encoder registry with "logstash" URI scheme.
  • Logback style JSON Encoder to encoder registry with "logback" URI scheme.
